name: Call of Cthulhu: Dark Corners of the Earth

locations.note: On 6 September 1915 detective Jack Walters is called to the siege of a manor, where a mass suicide and a portal leave him with amnesia.

In February 1922 Jack Walters takes a missing-person case in Innsmouth, escapes a mob and corrupt police, then joins the FBI raid on the Marsh Gold Refinery and the assault on the Order of Dagon's headquarters.

routes.name: Walters's investigation
routes.note: The game moves between Walters's Boston history and his later investigation in Innsmouth; these episodes span different years.
